node.title: Re^2: Shrink Images and PDFs
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
For your PDF files, what does gs do or not do which reduce the PDF file size? Is it mainly ebook option?

Yes, I've found [https://www.ghostscript.com/doc/9.26/VectorDevices.htm#distillerparams|the ebook option] a convenient way to downsample the resolution of the images embedded in a PDF to 150 DPI. So this script will have a significant effect on PDF files that are large due to them containing high-resolution images (like scans), and less of an effect on PDFs that are already smaller than ~1MB.
